rows.enforcement_point: broker response verifier and resource PEP
rows.positive: enterprise subject survives exchange and resource call
rows.mutation_expected_red: substituted subject reaches the resource while the positive remains valid
rows.observation: verified subject at broker and resource

rows.positive: SPIRE JWT-SVID signed by the configured bundle is accepted
rows.negative: present an attacker-signed actor while the trusted JWKS is configured
rows.expected_denial: token endpoint denies and no credential or resource attempt exists
rows.mutation: replace the configured trusted actor JWKS with the attacker JWKS and assert the replacement applied
rows.mutation_expected_red: the previously denied attacker actor is accepted; restore trusted JWKS then rerun valid and attacker controls
rows.observation: named positive/negative status and exact configured JWKS digest

rows.negative: present an actor minted for another audience
rows.expected_denial: token endpoint denies and no credential is issued
rows.mutation_expected_red: wrong-audience actor is accepted; restore then prove positive and denial
rows.observation: token endpoint result and configured audience

rows.enforcement_point: broker sealed-state comparator and resource PEP
rows.positive: issued act.sub equals the separately sealed immutable run-ID SPIFFE identity
rows.negative: use another live run's valid actor
rows.mutation_expected_red: other-run actor reaches resource; restore then prove exact-run positive and denial
rows.observation: sealed actor, verified act.sub, broker and resource result

rows.enforcement_point: broker preflight and provider AS actor-assertion validator
rows.negative: use expired, future, and overlong actor assertions
rows.expected_denial: exchange is denied before resource dispatch
rows.mutation: remove original exp-minus-iat actor lifetime ceiling
rows.mutation_expected_red: overlong fresh actor is accepted; restore then prove positive and all denials
rows.observation: typed iat/exp and exchange/resource attempt counts

rows.enforcement_point: provider AS/PDP policy, broker response verifier, and resource PEP
rows.positive: one identical audience/resource identifier and narrowed action set pass
rows.negative: use distinct audience/resource or widen target or scope
rows.expected_denial: configuration or broker denies before resource dispatch
rows.mutation: remove returned target or scope subset comparison separately
rows.mutation_expected_red: widened target or scope reaches resource; restore then prove positive and denials
rows.observation: wire target, signed token audience/scope, and resource decision

rows.enforcement_point: certified Envoy MCP extractor, broker sealed-pin comparator, and resource PEP
rows.positive: canonical protected operation argument equals sealed pin and resource policy
rows.negative: change the protected operation argument while retaining token and actor
rows.expected_denial: broker extractor and resource PEP each deny without protected action
rows.mutation: first isolate and remove each comparator to prove its local negative turns red; then remove both in the composed path
rows.mutation_expected_red: each isolated attack executes only with its local comparator removed, and the composed attack executes only with both removed; restore then prove defense-in-depth denial
rows.observation: one canonical argument at extractor, sealed broker pin, resource policy input, and execution count

rows.enforcement_point: resource PEP validates DPoP cnf, ath, htm, htu, iat and jti against the live request with fail-closed per-run replay partitions
rows.positive: issued cnf matches the DPoP proof key, one proof executes once, and eight run partitions retain every live JTI within 4096 aggregate entries and 16 MiB
rows.negative: use another holder, swap token/proof, change target, replay one proof, saturate one 512-entry run partition, then replay another run's earliest live proof and overflow the aggregate
rows.expected_denial: resource PEP denies every binding/replay attack and fails closed on per-run or aggregate capacity before protected action
rows.mutation: remove cnf, ath, target and replay enforcement separately, then replace per-run partitioning with a shared evicting cache and assert the mutation applied
rows.mutation_expected_red: the matching binding attack executes for each applied mutation and noisy-run saturation evicts another run's live JTI so its exact replay executes; restore then prove positive, non-eviction, capacity denial and all binding denials
rows.observation: token cnf, proof key/claims, per-run and aggregate replay entries, measured replay memory, partition identity, eviction count, and resource execution count

rows.enforcement_point: Envoy ext_authz configuration, broker transport and supervisor
rows.positive: one request produces at most one AS attempt and releases its permit
rows.negative: timeout, downstream disconnect, reset, cancellation, and ambiguous AS response
rows.expected_denial: no retry or late resource dispatch; permit releases within bound; late issuance is recorded not claimed absent
rows.mutation: enable Envoy ext_authz retry and remove cancellation/attempt ceilings separately
rows.mutation_expected_red: duplicate AS attempt or late resource dispatch is observed; restore then prove positive and denials
rows.observation: correlated Envoy, broker, AS and resource attempt counts plus permit timing

rows.enforcement_point: provider AS/PDP policy, broker admission and resource PEP
rows.positive: independently named AS/JWKS, client-auth, sender-key, policy and certification versions rotate within their overlap while the immutable sealed authority of the live run ID remains unchanged
rows.negative: revoke or rotate each version independently, change registry or another sealed authority dimension, and halt the run independently
rows.expected_denial: version rotation closes old authorization within its bound; registry or sealed-authority change halts the old run and requires a new run ID; without active revocation an already issued token is observed until its declared 300-second residual expires
rows.mutation: retain stale version authority, mutate sealed authority under the same run ID, or retain authority after run halt
rows.mutation_expected_red: stale authorization, same-run authority mutation or execution survives beyond its declared bound; restore then prove fresh positive and bounded residual
rows.observation: run liveness and ID, sealed registry/authority digest, named policy/key/certification versions, issuance and execution times, active revocation result and residual expiry

rows.enforcement_point: sidecar supervisor, Envoy admission, Kubernetes fencing and resource PEP
rows.negative: halt during exchange and upstream dispatch
rows.expected_denial: new broker admission closes within 1s, Envoy dies within 5s, saved DPoP proof expires within 5s, workload fences within 10s, and Pod deletes within 60s; late issuance is recorded
rows.mutation: remove admission close, hard kill, proof freshness, workload fence and deletion separately
rows.mutation_expected_red: the corresponding deadline or post-halt execution fails; restore then prove positive and all bounds
rows.observation: monotonic admission, proof, process, fence, Pod, issuance and resource timestamps

rows.enforcement_point: Pod filesystem, Workload API, OpenBao, Envoy and bounded telemetry sinks
rows.positive: trusted sidecar obtains only its bounded materials
rows.negative: agent probes sockets, mounts, environment, proc, cores, logs and traces
rows.expected_denial: agent cannot read any credential or signing material
rows.mutation: expose each enumerated secret surface to the agent independently
rows.mutation_expected_red: the named secret becomes readable and the assertion fails; restore then prove every surface absent
rows.observation: agent reads plus bounded artifact/log/trace scans
